name: Coffee Break
source:
An office simulator that has everything you miss about going to work:
-Looming project deadline!
-Pile of dishes in the sink!
-Fixing a broken printer!
-Talkative rodent co-workers!
-Free coffee!

Created for the MCPG Gallery Project, 2020.

[From [url=https://lumpyj.itch.io/coffee-break]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款办公室模拟游戏，包含你怀念的那些上班体验：
－步步逼近的项目截止日期！
－水槽里堆积如山的餐具！
－修理坏掉的打印机！
－喋喋不休的啮齿类同事！
－免费咖啡！

为2020年MCPG Gallery Project制作。

[摘自[url=https://lumpyj.itch.io/coffee-break]Itch.io[/url]]
